metadata.title: From Feed to Agent — Evidence Handoff Product Strategy
metadata.author: Sihan Xu

survey.layer_relationship: The expanded layer includes all 73 primary respondents plus 49 additional respondents.
survey.interpretation: Anonymous convenience-sample retrospective choices; descriptive signals, not population estimates.

platform_roles.observed_strength_and_risk: High creator identity visibility and experiential language; weaker constraint coverage and sparse explicit incentive disclosure in captured captions.
platform_roles.product_implication: Use for possibility discovery and creator context, then hand claims into a verifiable layer.
platform_roles.interpretation_boundary: Captured task-fit role; no cross-surface rank

platform_roles.observed_strength_and_risk: Direct channels and labeled sponsored modules are legible, but title/metadata alone often do not satisfy a complex scenario.
platform_roles.product_implication: Use to choose which review to watch; this study did not score the videos themselves.
platform_roles.interpretation_boundary: Captured task-fit role; no cross-surface rank

platform_roles.task_fit_role: Source-linked synthesis with an operational caveat
platform_roles.observed_strength_and_risk: Generated answers usually covered constraints and exposed links, but 8/24 Round 2 tasks returned fallback results without an AI answer; three narrow validation errors were observed.
platform_roles.product_implication: Use for synthesis only with generation-state handling and a verification queue for consequential claims.
platform_roles.interpretation_boundary: Captured task-fit role; no cross-surface rank

platform_roles.observed_strength_and_risk: Generated all 48 initial answers and consistently framed task constraints and trade-offs; the structured record did not preserve every source-button destination URL.
platform_roles.product_implication: Use to structure the decision, while exporting durable claim-level links and creator provenance.
platform_roles.interpretation_boundary: Captured task-fit role; no cross-surface rank

product_thesis: Build a consent-based evidence bridge that carries intent, preserves origin, exposes uncertainty, and makes verification portable.
concept_status: Evidence-backed concept; adoption, willingness-to-pay, and product-market-fit tests are next.
publication_boundaries: Search findings cover captured visible result pages; videos were not watched.
Agent findings cover complete initial answers only.
Only six named validation tasks were truth-checked.
Survey results are anonymous convenience-sample descriptive signals.
